Arches whose stems rise from one track to tops on another

Source: R/seq_cross_arch.R
seq_cross_arch.Rd

Draws, per row, vertical stems at one or two genomic anchors starting at y0 on the track the element is added to, joined by a Bezier arch whose tops sit at top on the target track. Both tracks must use the same windows: x is shared and only y maps across tracks, through the target track's panels (and its y transform, e.g. seq_scale_count()). Rows without a second anchor draw a single stem with a pennant. Optional interval glyphs (see seq_interval_glyph()) are drawn on both stems at the top, and an optional marker point on each stem at marker in source track units. An anchor outside every window is an error naming the row.

Usage

seq_cross_arch(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  target,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  legend = NULL,
  legend_extra = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "canvas_margin",
  legend_side = "right",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

GRanges or data.frame with one row per arch.

mapping

SeqMap from map(). Fields: x0 (default start), chrom0 (default seqnames for GRanges), x1 and chrom1 (second anchor; NA or unmapped gives a single stem; chrom1 defaults to chrom0), top (arch top in target track units; NA peaks at the target axis top), y0 (stem base, default 0), color, alpha, glyph, bar_lo, bar_hi (glyph type and bar in target track units), marker (point on each stem), caution (logical; draws a caution mark) and id (row label used in error messages).

target

track_id of the track holding the arch tops.

aesthetics

SeqAes from aes(): linewidth (1.2), curve (0.04 npc), color, alpha, bar_linewidth (4), bar_alpha (1), glyph_points (TRUE), size (glyph point size in mm, 2), cap_mm (2.5), marker_size (0.8), marker_shape (16), single_mm (pennant width, 1.6), caution_mm (1.6).

legend

NULL (no keys of its own), FALSE, a SeqLegendSpec or a list of LegendKey objects used as given.

legend_extra

Optional LegendKey or list of them appended.

show_legend

Logical. FALSE suppresses the legend.

legend_position, legend_side

Placement of the built legend.

...

Passed to the generator (e.g. t0 for a plot-level link).

Value

A SeqCrossArch link element; add it to the source track.

Details

coordCanvas holds one list per row with canvas npc values row, x0, y0, x1, y1, top0, top1, single, color, lwd, glyph, lo0, hi0, lo1, hi1, ytop, marker0, marker1, caution.

Examples

library(GenomicRanges)
win <- GRanges("chr1", IRanges(1, 1e6))
sv <- data.frame(chr = "chr1", pos1 = 2e5, pos2 = 6e5, t = 0.4)
p <- seq_plot() %+%
  seq_track(track_id = "top", windows = win,
            scale_y = seq_scale_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))) %+%
  seq_track(track_id = "base", windows = win,
            scale_y = seq_scale_continuous(limits = c(0, 4))) %+%
  seq_cross_arch(sv, map(chrom0 = chr, x0 = pos1, x1 = pos2, top = t),
                 target = "top")
